<user_query>
Read-only exploration. Locate and summarize current learning record UI and data flow for export planning. Focus files: frontend/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue and related helpers/components used there. Return: (1) current filters and list grouping, (2) what fields are shown per record, (3) current user role logic (teacher/director), (4) where an export button could fit with minimal disruption, (5) any existing print/image utilities in frontend.
</user_query>

I’ll inspect `LearningRecordsPage.vue` and trace its imported helpers/components to map filters, grouping, displayed fields, role behavior, and existing print/image utilities for export planning. I’m starting with targeted searches, then I’ll read the relevant files and summarize with concrete file references.
I’ve mapped the page itself; next I’ll quickly inspect `classSessionsApi`, `SearchableSelect`, and role wiring in `App.vue`, then scan frontend for any reusable print/image utilities.

Current learning-record UI/data flow is centralized in:

- `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue`
- helper: `/home/admin/frontend/src/lib/classSessionsApi.js`
- shared select: `/home/admin/frontend/src/components/SearchableSelect.vue`
- page wiring: `/home/admin/frontend/src/App.vue`

## 1) Current filters and list grouping

- **Filters in UI** (`LearningRecordsPage.vue`):
  - `student_name` text search
  - `teacher_id` (via `SearchableSelect`) — shown only when `!isTeacher`
  - `status` dropdown: `pending / approved / rejected / changes_requested`
  - manual **搜尋** button triggers `fetchRecords()`
- **API query built by filters**:
  - `GET /api/v1/learning-records`
  - params include `branch_id`, optional `student_name`, `teacher_id`, `status`, plus fixed `sort=session_date`, `per_page=200`
- **Grouping logic**:
  - Records are grouped by student (`student_id` preferred, fallback to student name key)
  - Each group computes `pending_count` (`pending` + `changes_requested`)
  - Group records sorted by `SessionDate desc`, then `StartTime desc`
  - Groups sorted by student name (`Intl.Collator('zh-Hant')`)
  - UI renders each group in a `<details>` accordion; first group opens by default

## 2) Fields shown per record

In the grouped table row, each record shows:

- **Date/time**: `SessionDate`, `StartTime`
- **Student block**: `student_name`, and class label (`student_class_label` fallback `Subject`)
- **Subject**: `Subject` (tag)
- **Teacher**: `teacher_name` (only for non-teacher view)
- **Status**: `Status` mapped to label/tag class
- **Actions**: `檢視`, `編輯` (conditional), `換老師` (director roles), `核准`, `退回`, `退回待審`, `刪除`, plus time-lock hint

Modal form exposes full learning-record content fields:

- `StudentID`, `TeacherID`, `ClassSessionID`, `Subject`, `SessionDate`, `StartTime`, `EndTime`
- `HomeworkStatus`, `QuizScore`, `Progress`, `NextHomework`, `Performance`, `Comment`
- `Status`, `ReviewNote` (read-only display for rejected/changes_requested note)

## 3) Current user role logic (teacher/director)

- Role props come from `/home/admin/frontend/src/App.vue`:
  - `<LearningRecordsPage ... :user-role="role" :user-id="session.user.id" :branch-id="currentBranch" />`
- In page logic:
  - `isTeacher = (userRole === 'teacher')`
  - `isDirectorRole = userRole in ['director','admin','super_admin']`
- **Teacher behavior**:
  - Header text changes to “我的課表 & 評量”
  - Gets teacher schedule widget (today/week) built from class sessions
  - Cannot use teacher filter
  - Form enforces schedule-based filling (`ClassSessionID` required), and time lock before class ends
  - Approved records are read-only for teacher
- **Director/admin/super_admin behavior**:
  - Sees full management header and “一鍵補登” button
  - Can filter by teacher
  - Can approve/reject/rollback/change teacher/delete
  - Can edit approved records (override read-only)

## 4) Best place for export button (minimal disruption)

Lowest-friction placements in current layout:

- **Primary recommendation**: page header action area (same row as `+ 新增評量` and `一鍵補登`)
  - This keeps export as a page-level action and avoids disturbing table/group structure.
- **Alternative**: filter card action area near **搜尋** button
  - Useful if export should explicitly follow current filter state.
- For minimal code churn, add one button in header, wire to a new handler reusing existing `filters` + `branch_id` query composition from `fetchRecords()`.

## 5) Existing print/image utilities in frontend

From current frontend scan:

- **No generic print utility** found (`window.print`, print helpers not present).
- **No PDF/image export libs** found (`html2canvas`, `jspdf`, canvas-based export not present).
- Existing related utility is only **CSV download via Blob + `URL.createObjectURL`** in:
  - `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/TeachersList.vue` (`downloadBulkCredentialsCsv`)
- There is a generic `downloadExport(type)` in `/home/admin/frontend/src/api.js`, but currently it is a stub (`console.log('Export not supported')`) and not used by `LearningRecordsPage.vue`.

If you want, I can next draft a no-code export integration plan (API contract + exact UI hook point + payload/filename rules) based on this current flow.
